<!-- Basic -->
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="" name="keywords"/>
<meta content="AWS Mining" name="description"/>
<meta content="Infinity Systems" name="author"/>

<!-- Theme CSS -->
<link href="/login-register/styles/main.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="/login-register/styles/vendor.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>

        #captcha {
            text-align: center;
            height: 50px;
            max-width: 135px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .container__captcha_image img {
            max-width: 135px;
        }

        .dropdown {
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .dropdown-content {
            display: none;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 1px solid #ccc;
            border-radius: 4px;
            position: absolute;
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .dropdown-content a {
            padding: 4px 8px;
            display: block;
        }

        .dropdown-content a:hover {
            background-color: #f1f1f1
        }

        .dropdown:hover .dropdown-content {
            display: block;
        }

        .dropdown:hover .dropbtn {
            background-color: #3e8e41;
        }


        #radioBtn .notActive {
            color: #010101;
            background-color: #fff;
        }


        @keyframes  pulse_animation {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            30% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
                transform: scale(1.08);
            }
            50% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            60% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            70% {
                transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            80% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        .pulse {
            animation-name: pulse_animation;
            animation-duration: 4000ms;
            transform-origin: 70% 70%;
            animation-iteration-count: infinite;
            animation-timing-function: linear;
        }

        .notActive {
            background-color: #5cb85c;
            color: white;
        }

        .active {
            background-color: #A7A7A7;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-flags {
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-question {
            height: 33px;
        }

        /* ---- reset ---- */
        canvas {
            display: absolute;
            vertical-align: bottom;
        }

        /* ---- particles.js container ---- */
        #particles-js {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background-color: #fff;
            background-image: url("");
            background-repeat: no-repeat;
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: 50% 50%;
        }

        #container {
            position: absolute;
            /*top: 50%;*/
            right: 50%;
            max-width: 90%;
        }
    </style>
</head>

<script>


    $(function () {
//        $("#status label").click(function () {
//            var clicked = $(this).children('input').attr('id');
//            if (clicked == 'yes') {
//                $("#resposta").show();
//                $("#tem_indicador").val(1);
//            } else {
//                $("#resposta").hide();
//                $("#tem_indicador").val(0);
//            }
//        });


                        
        $(".language_select").click(function () {
            if (!$(this).attr('data-lang')) {
                return false;
            }
            $("#language-selected").val($(this).attr('data-lang'));
        });

        $(".error").hide();
        
        $("#submitForm").click(function () {
            var valid = true;
            var indicador = $("#indicador").val();
            var username = $("#username").val();
            var inputEmail = $("#inputEmail").val();
            var inputPassword = $("#inputPassword").val();
            var inputPasswordCheck = $("#inputPasswordCheck").val();
            var indicador = $("#indicador").val();
            var tem_indicador = $("#tem_indicador").val();
            var pais = $("#selectPaises").val();


            if (indicador.length < 1) {
                $("#username").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_indicador").html('Sponsor is required');
                $("#error_indicador").show();
                valid = false;
            } else if (username.length > 20) {
                $("#username").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_indicador").html('perfil.Indicador não pode ter mais de 20 caracteres');
                $("#error_indicador").show();
                valid = false;
            } else if (username.indexOf(' ') !== -1) {
                $("#username").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_indicador").html('Invalid Characteres');
                $("#error_indicador").show();
                valid = false;
            } else {
                $("#error_indicador").hide();
            }

            if (username.length < 1) {
                $("#username").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_username2").html('User is required');
                $("#error_username2").show();
                valid = false;
            } else if (username.length > 20) {
                $("#username").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_username2").html('Username can not be longer than 20 characters');
                $("#error_username2").show();
                valid = false;
            } else if (username.indexOf(' ') !== -1) {
                $("#username").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_username2").html('Invalid Characteres');
                $("#error_username2").show();
                valid = false;
            } else {
                $("#error_username2").hide();
            }

            if (inputEmail.length < 1) {
                $("#inputEmail").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_email").html('Email is required');
                $("#error_email").show();
                valid = false;
            } else {
                $("#error_email").hide();
            }

            if (inputPassword.length < 1) {
                $("#inputPassword").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_password").html('Password is required');
                $("#error_password").show();
                valid = false;
            } else {
                $("#error_password").hide();
            }

            if (pais.length < 1) {
                $("#selectPaises").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_paises").html('Choose a country');
                $("#error_paises").show();
                valid = false;
            } else {
                $("#error_paises").hide();
            }

            if (inputPassword != inputPasswordCheck || inputPassword < 1) {
                $("#inputPasswordCheck").addClass('form-control-danger');
                $("#error_password_check").html('It is mandatory to confirm the password, both typed must be identical');
                $("#error_password_check").show();
                valid = false;
            } else {
                $("#error_password_check").hide();
            }

            if (indicador.length < 1) {
                $("#error_indicador").html('The indicator must be valid');
                $("#error_indicador").show();
                valid = false;
            } else if (indicador.length > 1) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: "https://awsmining.com/patrocinador",
                    data: {
                        indicador: indicador
                    },
                    dataType: "json"
                }).done(function (response) {
                    if (response.status != "success") {
                        $("#indicador").addClass('form-control-danger');
                        $("#error_indicador").html('The indicator must be valid');
                        $("#error_indicador").show();
                        valid = false;
                    } else {
                        $("#id_indicador").val(response.vendedor_id);
                        $("#error_indicador").hide();
                    }

                    if (valid) {
                        $("#form").submit();
                    }
                });
            } else {
                if (valid) {
                    $("#form").submit();
                }
            }
        });

        $(".btn-select").each(function (e) {
            var value = $(this).find("ul li.selected").html();
            if (value != undefined) {
                $(this).find(".btn-select-input").val(value);
                $(this).find(".btn-select-value").html(value);
            }
        });

        $("input[name$='question']").click(function () {
            var test = $(this).val();

            $("div.desc").hide();
            $("#resposta" + test).show();
        });

    });


    function verificaCountry() {
        var paiseSelected = $("#selectPaises").val();

        alert(paiseSelected);
    }

    $(document).on('click', '.btn-select', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var ul = $(this).find("ul");
        if ($(this).hasClass("active")) {
            if (ul.find("li").is(e.target)) {
                var target = $(e.target);
                target.addClass("selected").siblings().removeClass("selected");
                var value = target.html();
                $(this).find(".btn-select-input").val(value);
                $(this).find(".btn-select-value").html(value);
            }
            ul.hide();
            $(this).removeClass("active");
        } else {
            $('.btn-select').not(this).each(function () {
                $(this).removeClass("active").find("ul").hide();
            });
            ul.slideDown(300);
            $(this).addClass("active");
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', function (e) {
        var target = $(e.target).closest(".btn-select");
        if (!target.length) {
            $(".btn-select").removeClass("active").find("ul").hide();
        }
    });

    //    $('#yes').on('click', function(){
    //        $('#yes').removeClass('active').addClass('notActive');
    //        $('#no').removeClass('notActive').addClass('active');
    //    });
    //    $('#no').on('click', function(){

    //        $('#yes').removeClass('notActive').addClass('active');

    function flipped() {
        $('.flip').find('.card').toggleClass('flipped');
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {

        $('#login').show();
        $('#reset').hide();
        $('#register').hide();

                $('#login').show();
        $('#reset').hide();
        $('#register').hide();
        
        $('#btn-register').click(function () {
            flipped();
            $('#register').show();
            $('#btn-password').show();
            $('#login').hide();
            $('#reset').hide();
            return false;
        });

        $('#btn-password').click(function () {
            flipped();
            $('#btn-password').hide();
            $('#login').hide();
            $('#register').hide();
            $('#reset').show();
            return false;
        });

        //LINK DE CADASTRO QUANDO ENVIADO NAO ABRIR OPCAO DE TROCAR PATROCINADOR
        var url = window.location.href;
        console.log(url);
        var link = url.split("/");
        console.log(link);

        if (link.length < 5) {
            $("#indicador").val('');
            document.getElementById("sponsorInput").style.display = "none";
        } else {
            flipped();
            $('#register').show();
            $('#btn-password').show();
            $('#login').hide();
            $('#reset').hide();
            return false;

            document.getElementById("sponsorInput").style.display = "block";
        }

    });

    function backLogin() {
        flipped();
        $('#btn-password').show();
        $('#login').show();
        $('#register').hide();
        $('#reset').hide();
        return false;
    }

    particlesJS("particles-js", {
        "particles": {
            "number": {"value": 80, "density": {"enable": true, "value_area": 800}},
            "color": {"value": "#e66d00"},
            "shape": {
                "type": "circle",
                "stroke": {"width": 0, "color": "#000000"},
                "polygon": {"nb_sides": 5},
                "image": {"src": "img/github.svg", "width": 100, "height": 100}
            },
            "opacity": {
                "value": 0.5, "random": false,
                "anim": {"enable": false, "speed": 1, "opacity_min": 0.1, "sync": false}
            },
            "size": {
                "value": 3, "random": true,
                "anim": {"enable": false, "speed": 40, "size_min": 0.1, "sync": false}
            },
            "line_linked": {"enable": true, "distance": 150, "color": "#e66d00", "opacity": 0.4, "width": 1},
            "move": {
                "enable": true, "speed": 6, "direction": "none", "random": false,
                "straight": false,
                "out_mode": "out",
                "bounce": false,
                "attract": {"enable": false, "rotateX": 600, "rotateY": 1200}
            }
        },
        "interactivity": {
            "detect_on": "canvas",
            "events": {
                "onhover": {"enable": true, "mode": "grab"},
                "onclick": {"enable": true, "mode": "push"},
                "resize": true
            },
            "modes": {
                "grab": {
                    "distance": 133.99274002972194,
                    "line_linked": {"opacity": 1}
                },
                "bubble": {"distance": 400, "size": 40, "duration": 2, "opacity": 8, "speed": 3},
                "repulse": {"distance": 200, "duration": 0.4},
                "push": {"particles_nb": 4},
                "remove": {"particles_nb": 2}
            }
        },
        "retina_detect": true
    });
    var count_particles, stats, update;
    stats = new Stats;
    stats.setMode(0);
    stats.domElement.style.position = 'absolute';
    stats.domElement.style.left = '0px';
    stats.domElement.style.top = '0px';
    document.body.appendChild(stats.domElement);
    count_particles = document.querySelector('.js-count-particles');
    update = function () {
        stats.begin();
        stats.end();
        if (window.pJSDom[0].pJS.particles && window.pJSDom[0].pJS.particles.array) {
            count_particles.innerText = window.pJSDom[0].pJS.particles.array.length;
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(update);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
    ;

</script>
